summary: community.general deprecated more keycloak redirects to middleware_automation.keycloak (clientscope, clientscope_rolemappings, clientscope_type renamed to client_scope names, clientsecret info/regenerate, clienttemplate, component), for removal in 16.0.0.
questions: What is the new name for keycloak_clientscope?
Is keycloak_clientsecret_info being removed from community.general?

answer_card.title: community.general keycloak redirects deprecated (clients)
answer_card.answer_md:
These community.general **redirects** to `middleware_automation.keycloak` are deprecated and will be removed in **community.general 16.0.0**. Switch your tasks to the FQCN `middleware_automation.keycloak.<module>` now (install it with `ansible-galaxy collection install middleware_automation.keycloak`).

- `keycloak_clientscope` → `middleware_automation.keycloak.keycloak_client_scope`
- `keycloak_clientscope_rolemappings` → `...keycloak_client_scope_rolemappings`
- `keycloak_clientscope_type` → `...keycloak_client_scope_type`
- `keycloak_clientsecret_info`, `keycloak_clientsecret_regenerate`, `keycloak_clienttemplate`, `keycloak_component` (same names)
